BiblicalUsage: Shemaah the Gibeathite was the father of Ahiezer and Joash, who came to David at Ziklag among the mighty men. His sons are named as the chief and his brother, and the father's name is carried by his sons' courage.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe fathers are remembered in their sons' loyalty. Shemaah's boys came to David when he was an outlaw, and I hold that such loyalty is a family trait worth naming.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
